dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge shows a subtle concave curvature transitioning from the apex to a linear mid-section, ending in a flared basal attachment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium-radius pixel curve at the highest point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin presenting a consistent positive slope of approximately 50-55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Dorsal fin base-to-height ratio is approximately 1.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the lateral flank; significant irregular white depigmentation/lesions distributed across the dorsal fin and flank; multiple small notches and irregularities on the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced mottled skin texture with high-frequency light-colored blotches on a dark grey background.
